Bailey’s Bake Shoppe — Bakery in Lancaster, PA. Custom Cakes, Cupcakes & Pastries.

Bailey’s Bake Shoppe is a family-run bakery at 6 Beaver Valley Pike, Willow Street, Pennsylvania (Lancaster County), proudly serving Lancaster, York, Strasburg, Millersville, New Holland, Mount Joy, Quarryville, and the surrounding region.

We specialize in custom cakes, wedding cakes, birthday cakes, cupcakes, pastries, brownies, cookies, scones, dessert cups, and Tandy cakes — all baked fresh in-house.

Hours: Wednesday–Friday 7:00am–3:00pm, Saturday 8:00am–2:00pm. Closed Sunday–Tuesday.

Contact: bailey@baileysbakeshoppe.com · (717) 229-6574.
